cd /private/var/folders/kp/vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn/T/barcode-sqjlwc3_; cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-private-var-folders-kp-vdv61pd97vd0x29b257r8h7h0000gn-T-barcode-sqjlwc3-/2fbff88e-0393-44a9-ac8c-7893273c6c7f/scratchpad/c.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np,subprocess
from PIL import Image
b=np.array(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)[100]
N=len(b)
for L in 'ABCDEFGHIJ':
    raw=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','quiet','-i',f'videos/{L}.mp4','-vf','fps=2,scale=1:1','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-'],capture_output=True).stdout
    a=np.frombuffer(raw,np.uint8).reshape(-1,3).astype(float)
    idx=np.linspace(0,len(a)-1,N).astype(int)
    # bin average
    edges=np.linspace(0,len(a),N+1).astype(int)
    v=np.array([a[edges[i]:max(edges[i+1],edges[i]+1)].mean(0) for i in range(N)])
    print(L,np.abs(v-b).mean())
EOF
